description: Key visible artifacts per selected case, verified by the assistant on the original keyframes (contact sheets and full-resolution frames). Each run of each pipeline is matched against this list. expected_labels states the labels the v2 definitions call for; v1 had no dual labels. kind: missed_by_v1 / misfiled_by_v1 / found_by_v1 / control (a consistency the evaluator should NOT flag). Assistant judgment, not human annotation.

cases.why: V-L/V-V categorization: v1 filed two cross-shot changes as V-L only (one in the wrong shot) and missed the man's changing identity.

artifacts.title: Shirt changes in Shot3
artifacts.detail: Shots 1, 2, 4 show the described faded blue-gray T-shirt; Shot3 shows a dark collared button-down shirt.

artifacts.title: Sofa becomes a round armchair
artifacts.detail: "the same Beige sofa": low straight sofa in Shots 1-3, tall rounded tub chair in Shot4.

artifacts.title: The man's face and hair change
artifacts.detail: "Maintain the same man": hair volume, hairline and face differ across Shots 1-4 (large rounded curls in Shot2, short hair in Shot3).

artifacts.title: Arms not resting low in Shot1
artifacts.detail: Shot1 asks for arms resting low; the arms stretch along the sofa back in every frame.

cases.why: Owner example: courtyard background of Shot1 and Shot3 is inconsistent, missed by v1.

artifacts.title: Courtyard changes between Shot1 and Shot3
artifacts.detail: "retain the courtyard continuity" / "remains in the same wintry courtyard": tall dark stone building with balustraded stairs behind the woman in Shot1; low beige single-storey building and bench behind her in Shot3, from a comparable frontal view.

artifacts.title: Woman's coat changes style
artifacts.detail: Belted wrap coat without visible buttons in Shot1; double-breasted buttoned coat with a peach scarf in Shot3.

artifacts.title: Wide-brim hat instead of earflap hat
artifacts.detail: The older man wears a black wide-brim hat in Shots 2 and 4; the prompt asks for a black earflap hat.

artifacts.title: Shot4 starts with his back to the camera
artifacts.detail: Shot4 should start with his face lowered in screen-left profile; frame 0 shows his back.

artifacts.title: Hand leaves the pocket in Shot2
artifacts.detail: He should keep his hands in his pockets; at the end of Shot2 he lifts a hand to his hat.

cases.why: Control for the owner example: StoryMem keeps the courtyard consistent; a correct evaluator should not flag it.

artifacts.title: Courtyard stays consistent (should NOT be flagged)
artifacts.detail: Same spruce trees, pale stone building and balustrade behind the woman in Shots 1 and 3.

artifacts.title: Neckline changes in Shot2
artifacts.detail: Peach high turtleneck in Shots 1 and 3; deep V-neck with a choker in Shot2.

artifacts.title: Shot3 repeats Shot1 instead of a closer view
artifacts.detail: Shot3 asks for a closer waist-up view; it reuses Shot1's framing, background and pose.

cases.why: Owner example: the turquoise woman's clothing (and look) changes across shots, missed by v1.

artifacts.title: Turquoise woman's top changes
artifacts.detail: Plain top with a dark strap (Shot2), scattered dark marks (Shot4), dark shoulder print (Shot6), dense palm print over a white long-sleeve layer (Shot8).

artifacts.title: Turquoise woman's face and hair change
artifacts.detail: Different faces across her shots; Shot6 has dark curly hair with bold blonde streaks.

artifacts.title: Robe woman's hair falls loose in Shot7
artifacts.detail: Hair pulled back (prompt, Shots 1/3/5); long and loose in Shot7.

artifacts.title: The "familiar blue chair" changes type
artifacts.detail: Small upright chair in Shots 1 and 5; long blue lounger in Shots 3 and 7.

artifacts.title: Cheek contact lost in Shot8
artifacts.detail: "Maintain the cheek contact": no hand touches her cheek in the last frames of Shot8.

cases.why: Missed transition failure: one continuous take instead of eight shots; the two women merge into one.

artifacts.title: No cut at any of the 7 boundaries
artifacts.detail: All eight 5-second intervals show the same static take of one woman by the sea.

artifacts.title: Robe woman and turquoise woman merged
artifacts.detail: The two required characters (older woman in a white robe; younger brown-haired woman in turquoise) appear as one blonde woman in a teal wrap.

artifacts.title: Shot8 shoes and laces never appear
artifacts.detail: The required shoe-bearing gesture is absent.

artifacts.title: Exposure flash at the first frame
artifacts.detail: Shot1 frame 0 is much brighter than frames 1-5.

cases.why: Held-out transition failure: the person/hallway alternation never happens.

artifacts.title: No cut at any boundary
artifacts.detail: All four intervals are one nearly identical static close-up of the same person.

artifacts.title: Hallway shots replaced by the person
artifacts.detail: Shots 2 and 4 should show the empty hallway.

artifacts.title: Green flash at the first frame
artifacts.detail: Shot1 frame 0 is darker and green-tinted, then jumps to the steady look.

cases.why: Held-out: characters swap looks, a duplicate old man appears, recurring men change faces.

artifacts.title: Fighters swap looks in Shot4
artifacts.detail: The Ponytailed man's slot shows a shirtless man with loose light-brown hair; the Sleeveless man's slot shows a dark ponytail. Shots 3 and 5 have the opposite looks.

artifacts.title: A second old man appears in Shot6
artifacts.detail: Instead of the Sleeveless man's bare arm, a shirtless gray-bearded old man fills the foreground.

artifacts.title: The older man changes
artifacts.detail: Full gray ponytail in Shot2 (prompt: balding crown), balding in Shot8; olive shirt in Shot2, beige shirt over a white undershirt in Shot6.

artifacts.title: Sleeveless man's face changes
artifacts.detail: Young slicked-blond man in Shot5; older, heavier face in Shot7.

artifacts.title: Shot1 flips through the doorway
artifacts.detail: He should drop down out of view; he tumbles through the doorway.

cases.why: Held-out within-shot defects: dress pattern flickers, objects pop in, no cuts.

artifacts.title: No cuts
artifacts.detail: The same two-woman composition lasts all 20 s; Shots 2-4 should be single-person views.

artifacts.title: Floral dress flickers to plain and back
artifacts.detail: Within single shots the right-hand dress switches between floral and plain black (floral at frame 0 then plain in Shots 2 and 4; plain at frame 0 then floral in Shot3).

artifacts.title: Plant and basin pop in during Shot3
artifacts.detail: A white basin and green plant appear under the window from frame 1 without camera motion.

artifacts.title: Flash at the first frame
artifacts.detail: Shot1 frame 0 has a different, darker look than frames 1-5.

cases.why: Known-hard case: a static take with characters vanishing and morphing.

artifacts.title: No real shot structure
artifacts.detail: Nearly the whole video is one static, dark view of the elevator wall; the lobby, close-up and atrium shots never appear.

artifacts.title: Characters vanish and reappear
artifacts.detail: The frame shows an empty wall in Shot3 frames 1-3 and Shot6 frames 2-5, then people return in place.

artifacts.title: Woman turns into a man in Shot8
artifacts.detail: Frame 0 shows the woman; from frame 1 the same clothes and pose belong to a man.

artifacts.title: Required people and places missing
artifacts.detail: Lobby view, blue-shirted man and the Shot8 two-man view are absent.

artifacts.title: Dark flash at the first frame
artifacts.detail: Shot1 frame 0 is nearly black and green-tinted; frame 1 is back to the normal exposure.
